actionSuffix.description:
The name of the Redux action to be triggered.

When this action is clicked a Redux action will be triggered with this name ITEM_ACTION_CLICK_${actionSuffix}.

iconSuffix.description: The type of icon to render.

name.description: The human readable name of the action to display as text.

disabled.description: Whether the action is currently triggerable.

error.description: Where an error will be placed by epicRegistry if one is found. Will be undefined or false if there is no error.

disabledCondition.description:
Condition in which the action should appear disabled. If specified, takes precedence over {@link #disabled}.
If both {@link #disabledCondition} and {@link #hiddenCondition} are specified, the action will be hidden if
{@link hiddenCondition} is true.

disabledTooltip.description: The tooltip to display when the action is disabled

hiddenCondition.description:
Condition in which the action should be hidden.
If both {@link #disabledCondition} and {@link #hiddenCondition} are specified, the action will be hidden if
{@link hiddenCondition} is true.

hideWhenDisabled.description: If true, do not show this action if the row is disabled.

hideWhenEnabled.description: If true, do not show this action if the row is enabled.

usage.description: The usage type for this button.

title: Item actions for {@link UiSdlTreeList}, which are analogous to row actions in grids.
name: UiSdlTreeListItemAction
